name: URA rentals of non-landed homes, quarterly

measures.definition: Median monthly rent per sq ft of private non-landed homes (condominiums and private flats) in major projects with at least 10 contracts in the latest quarter, weighted by contracts, converted to m² and times 50 m².
The same rate per m² as the one-bedroom figure, times 90 m².

rights.attribution: Contains information from Rentals of Non-Landed Residential Buildings, Quarterly (Urban Redevelopment Authority) accessed from data.gov.sg, made available under the terms of the Singapore Open Data Licence version 1.0 (https://data.gov.sg/open-data-licence)
notices: Contains information from Rentals of Non-Landed Residential Buildings, Quarterly accessed from data.gov.sg, which is made available under the terms of the Singapore Open Data Licence version 1.0 https://data.gov.sg/open-data-licence

vetted.notes: Official contract rents; the Singapore Open Data Licence allows any use with the attribution notice. HDB's own median rents by town and flat type are also open (d_23000a00c52996c55106084ed0339566) and could join as a second figure.

caveats: Private condominiums and flats only; public (HDB) flats, cheaper and home to most residents, are not in it.
Smaller homes rent for more per sq ft, so a fixed 50 m² at the median rate is on the low side for a one-bedroom condominium.
